Officer's narrative
Officer narrative, League City, Texas. At approximately the time of the call, I responded to a rear-end collision on the
roadway involving two vehicles. Driver 1 was stopped in the travel lane when the front of Driver 2's vehicle struck the
rear of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 2 told me the impact occurred exactly as Driver 1 described it. Two independent
witnesses on the scene gave matching accounts, and the photographs I took show the rear-end damage that is
consistent with the reported impact. The damage is largely in line with the force of a collision of this kind. Driver 1
reported a wrist injury and said the impact threw them against the steering wheel. That injury is consistent with the
mechanism of this crash. Passenger was in the front seat and was confirmed present by Driver 1, Driver 2, and both
witnesses. Nothing observed or reported by anyone at the scene suggests prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle. Driver
1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering that vehicle, as shown on the proof of insurance presented at
the scene.
